Details: Due to high Forecast Unscheduled Operational Demand across the SWIS, AEMO is forecasting potential Low Reserve Conditions (LRC) for the peak period on 01/02/2026, 17:00 - 21:00. This is based on the High scenario load forecast, as a result of forecast heatwave conditions.The forecast condition level is Lack of Reserve 1 (LOR1).Market Participants are advised that should this LRC Declaration period eventuate:AEMO intervention may be required if Electric Storage Resource (ESR) facilities have an insufficient state of charge (SOC), as deemed by AEMO in advance of the specified peak period.All generation Facilities may receive a Dispatch Instruction.Facilities offering Essential System Services may be trapped at Enablement Maximum limits.Demand Side Programmes may receive a Dispatch Instruction for maximum curtailment capacity.Supplementary Capacity (SC) may be dispatched.Peak Demand Non-Co-Optimised Essential System Services may be activated.AEMO may take further actions to manage Power System Security and Reliability as required.

Required Market Participant and Network: MP - Ensure compliance with this Market Advisory & follow all Directions and Dispatch Instructions issued by AEMO.NO – No action required.
